item.title: Vic Doesn’t Ask A Single Question | Vic Michaelis Asks Hank Anything
item.description:
Vic Michaelis joins Hank to ask him if GMOs are bad, who has the most DNA, and if he will tell them a secret?

00:00 Introduction 03:17 Are GMOs actually bad? 15:31 Can someone have the most DNA? 22:34 Why are British people’s teeth known for being like that? 30:26 Why aren’t we giving zeppelins another try? 38:31 Say there’s an afterlife. If you exclude family/friends/loved ones who would you hope is meeting you to take you to the next place? 42:28 Can you tell me a secret?
